component.name: 521C
component.summary: Independent Linux control surface for QCY earbuds

description.p: 521C is an independent, unofficial, local-first desktop application for QCY earbuds on Linux. The first device profile is the QCY MeloBuds Pro (HT08): battery and firmware status, ANC/transparency scenes, game mode, wear detection, sleep mode and a preflight-gated find-earbuds chime, plus host integrations (MPRIS media control, codec status, system EQ).

Bluetooth access uses the system BlueZ stack over D-Bus; no root, no daemon replacement, no telemetry, no account. Unknown QCY devices stay read-only, and destructive commands are unreachable from the app.
